content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 19 is largely strong (19.1 professional/workmanlike + conformance warranty, 19.3 malicious code and Applicable Law, 19.4 repair/replace plus refund, 19.5 preserving express warranties). The single material failure is Section 19.2, which caps Deliverable conformity at fifteen days after delivery and expressly ends Vendor's correction and refund obligations after that date — below the fallback 90-day software conformance floor and corrosive of the 19.4 remedies. One surgical replace extends the period to ninety days, extends it to software, and deletes the cut-off, bringing the clause to the fallback level; the remaining Services and remedy elements were already met verbatim in 19.1 and 19.4.
